newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets tender for 2-yr, 3.75 pct Treasury notes.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets tender for 2-yr, 3.75 pct Treasury notes.

text.p: The German government on Monday set an auction for up to 12 billion marks of two-year, 3.75 percent coupon Treasury notes maturing on March 19, 1999.
Bids are due by 1000 GMT on Tuesday, March 18, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said in a statement.
The first interest payment is on March 19, 1998. The settlement date is on March 20 and the notes will be listed on securities exchanges on March 21.
